$comment: Derived from the 2026-06-05 probe on session_0146dWU8wPHNwLyNLLJLuTYL
(3438 events, 9 distinct types). This is a descriptive snapshot, not a
validation schema — the future probe under lib/transcripts/events/probe.py
will assert against this and surface drift. Maintain in lockstep with

query_params.after_id: string, cursor — set to response.last_id on subsequent pages; omit on first page

notes: Without the CCR header gate, the route 404s on the bare path and 400s
on un-gated queries (the generic /v1 list-handler validator only
accepts created_at[*], limit, order, page, types[] — a different
The org_uuid is per-operator, captured from any in-flight request to
this endpoint in DevTools Network tab; not derivable from session id.

response_envelope.first_id: string — first event's id in the page
response_envelope.last_id: string — last event's id; pass as ?after_id= for next page

user.notes: Operator-typed turns + tool_result echoes. image blocks are events-only — local jsonl doesn't carry upload metadata in the same shape.

assistant.notes: Same content block shape as local jsonl. thinking blocks carry the encoded `signature` field for Anthropic's verifiable thinking.

system.notes: Kitchen sink — hook lifecycle, thinking-token streaming, session init metadata, sub-agent task lifecycle. The init subtype carries cwd, claude_code_version, mcp_servers, skills, slash_commands, plugins — strictly richer than the local jsonl session header.

env_manager_log.notes: Container provisioning telemetry — sandbox alloc, clone steps, setup_script execution, cc start. data.category ∈ {init, ...}; data.extra.step_id ∈ {provision, clone, setup_script, start_cc, ...}. Not in local jsonl.

result.notes: Per-turn telemetry. modelUsage keyed by model id (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7[1m]') with cacheCreationInputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, costUSD, inputTokens, outputTokens, webSearchRequests. The richest token-accounting signal in the events stream.

tool_progress.notes: Streaming progress updates for long-running tool calls. Useful for the renderer if it wants to show 'bash running, elapsed 3s'; not load-bearing for archival fidelity.

control_request.notes: Session control plane (e.g. request.subtype='rename_session'). Drop for translator unless we want to surface session-rename history.

control_response.notes: Response counterpart to control_request, paired by request_id.

rate_limit_event.notes: Rate-limit telemetry (resetsAt, overageStatus, rateLimitType ∈ {five_hour, ...}). Not in local jsonl. Useful for substrate observability, not for renderer fidelity.

translator_targets.$comment: What lib/transcripts/events/translator.py should preserve when mapping events → renderer-compatible synthetic jsonl.

renderer_v3_schema_field_sources.first_user_uuid: first event with type='user' and isSynthetic≠true → uuid
renderer_v3_schema_field_sources.models: set of result.modelUsage keys ∪ system event 'model' field
renderer_v3_schema_field_sources.cwds: set of system events whose subtype='init' → cwd
renderer_v3_schema_field_sources.cc_version: first system event with claude_code_version set
